model: REIT AFFO capitalisation at cost of equity (engine route)

inputs.sbc_source: Management fees paid in units (the REIT's equivalent of SBC), added back inside reported Distributable Income: FY2025 9.876m, 1H2025 4.553m, 1H2026 8.884m (1H2026 results note (i)); TTM to 30 Jun 2026 = 14.2m, deducted from the AFFO stream so the unit count is held flat
inputs.share_count_basis: Units in issue at 30 Jun 2026: 2,446,173,860 (1H2026 results, EPU/DPU table). Held flat: management fees paid in units are charged in the AFFO stream instead; no buybacks; acquisitions are assumed equity/debt-funded at no accretion, so per-unit growth is organic only.
inputs.owner_affo_build: TTM Distributable Income (FY2025 268.051 - 1H2025 127.128 + 1H2026 150.668 = 291.6m) less Capex Reserves retained (2H2025 ~12.8m [DI 140.9 - 5.248c x ~2,441m units]; 1H2026 10.9m [DI 150.668 - distribution 139.775]) = 23.7m, less management fees paid in units 14.2m = 253.7m (10.37c/unit). 1H2026 annualised on the same basis = 261.8m (10.70c/unit), which is what year 1 (3.5% growth) lands on.
inputs.historical_debt_memo: Not deducted (AFFO is post-interest): borrowings 2,292.4m and cash 244.1m at 30 Jun 2026; aggregate leverage 34.0%; 71.2% of loans hedged; ICR 6.9x (5.1x on +100bp).
inputs.wacc_rationale: Cost of equity, SGD-based: 10y SGS ~2.2%, ERP 5.5%, beta ~0.95 for an externally managed, 34%-geared S-REIT with 43.5% single-tenant concentration = ~7.4%, rounded to 7.5% base; bull 7.0% (re-rating toward data-centre REIT peers), bear 8.5% (rate shock / tenant-concentration premium). No WACC: the flow is post-interest so it is capitalised at the cost of equity with net debt held at zero.
inputs.lease_treatment: Land-lease rents for Singapore leasehold sites are inside property expenses and hence inside DI. Lease-extension premiums (e.g. the $350m paid Dec-2025 for KDC SGP 7/8 tenure) are lumpy capital outlays not in DI; they are the reason terminal growth is held at or below inflation (finite tenure decays the perpetuity).
inputs.nci_treatment: Distributable Income is stated net of non-controlling interests (attributable to Unitholders), so no NCI deduction.
inputs.notes: MODEL: REIT AFFO capitalisation at cost of equity via the component engine. Routed by .claude/skills/dcf-methods/SKILL.md (REIT / property trust row): Keppel DC REIT is an externally managed S-REIT carrying data centres at IAS 40 fair value, so reported net income is dominated by revaluation gains (FY2025 NI 427.8m vs DI 268.1m) and owner-FCF/EBITDA/net debt do not mean what an operating-company DCF assumes. The stream is owner AFFO = Distributable Income - Capex Reserves - management fees paid in units, already after interest, tax and NCI. Engine mapping: base_revenue = owner AFFO, EBITDA margin 100%, SBC/D&A/capex/tax/WC all zero, discount rate = cost of equity, net debt = 0 (never subtract debt from a post-interest flow). No prior ticker memory entry; first valuation. Cross-check: NAV/unit 1.73 at 30 Jun 2026, so price is ~1.23x P/NAV; the 1H2026 annualised DPU (11.43c) gives a 5.4% yield at the current price.

historical_growth.growth_divergence_warning: Equity (16.5-20%) and revenue (10.7-16.8%) CAGRs diverge >30% from per-unit DPU growth (0.5-2.5%): aggregate growth was bought with unit issuance (preferential offering Oct-2025, +10.5% units) and debt. Book equity also includes IAS 40 revaluation gains. Per-unit DPU is the relevant compounding rate; EPS is fair-value noise and not used.
historical_growth.notes: No SBC in the conventional sense; the management-fee-in-units charge is the analogue and is deducted from the stream. FCF CAGRs are reported OCF - capex and are shown for completeness only.

base.narrative: Year 1 = 1H2026 run-rate (full Tokyo DC3 and 100% KDC SGP 3/4). Thereafter contractual escalations plus positive reversions (~10% in 1H2026) offset by hedges rolling to higher rates and the Cardiff vacancy; organic per-unit growth fades to 2%. No accretive M&A assumed.

bull.narrative: AI/hyperscale tightness keeps reversions strong, Cardiff and KDC SGP 1 are re-let/redeveloped, KDC SGP 8 new halls land 3Q2027, and rate cuts lower the refinancing drag.

bear.narrative: The 43.5% hyperscaler downsizes or renegotiates at renewal, occupancy stays near 92%, Guangdong receivables keep leaking, and hedges roll into higher rates; a rate shock widens the cost of equity.

scenario_narratives.base: Data-centre rents keep escalating and reverting positively, offset by higher finance costs as hedges roll; per-unit AFFO grows ~3% fading to 2%, capitalised at a 7.5% cost of equity.
scenario_narratives.bull: Structural APAC/European supply shortage and AI inference demand sustain high reversions and redevelopment upside; AFFO/unit grows 4-5% early and the cost of equity compresses to 7%.
scenario_narratives.bear: Single-hyperscaler concentration bites: a renewal loss or rent reset cuts AFFO ~7% over two years, recovery is slow, and the market demands an 8.5% cost of equity.

probability_weighted.weights_rationale: Symmetric 25/50/25: bear held above the 15% house default because one hyperscaler is 43.5% of rental income and occupancy just fell to 92.5%; bull equally plausible given ~45% FY2025 reversions and constrained Singapore/Tokyo supply.

valuation_philosophy.summary: A post-interest REIT distribution stream is worth what its owner AFFO (distributable income less capex reserves and fees paid in units) is worth capitalised at the unitholder's cost of equity. Debt is already paid inside the stream, so it is not deducted again. NAV per unit (1.73) is the asset-value cross-check.
key_risks_to_valuation: Single hyperscaler = 43.5% of 1H2026 rental income; a lost renewal is the bear case
Refinancing: 34% gearing, 71% hedged; each +100bp cuts ICR from 6.9x to 5.1x and DI by roughly 8-9m per 10% of debt repriced
Finite land tenure on Singapore assets requires periodic lease-extension premiums outside DI
Acquisition-led growth funded by unit issuance has delivered only 0.5-2.5% per-unit DPU growth despite 11-17% aggregate growth
Multi-currency income (JPY, EUR, GBP, AUD, CNY) hedged only to June 2027

data_sources.price: Yahoo Finance chart API (AJBU.SI, SGX) at inputs.price_as_of; 52-week range 2.01-2.44
data_sources.financials: Keppel DC REIT annual reports FY2015-FY2025 and 1H2026 results (Extracted/AJBU.SI_HalfYear_H1-2026.txt lines 62-100 and 290-336); AJBU.SI_Metrics.csv
